result.instructions: Tools for YouCanBook.me, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes YouCanBook.me data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run youcanbookme_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run youcanbookme_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run youcanbookme_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. youcanbookme_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List bookings (appointments) on the YouCanBookMe account. YCBM API: GET /v1/bookings. Filter by profileId (booking page), an after/before time window, cancelled status, and a free-text searchText; select fields with `fields`. Paginated via page (0-based) + maxResults. Returns a JSON array of bookings.

profileId.description: Restrict to bookings on this profile (booking page) id.

after.description: Only bookings starting AFTER this time (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-07-01T00:00:00Z).

before.description: Only bookings starting BEFORE this time (ISO 8601).

cancelled.description: Filter by cancelled status: true = only cancelled, false = only active. Omit for all.

searchText.description: Free-text search across booking fields (e.g. attendee name/email).

fields.description: Comma-separated field paths to return (e.g. "id,title,startsAt"). Supports dotted paths for nested objects. Omit to get the default field set.

page.description: Pagination page number, 0-based (offset-based paging). Use with maxResults.

maxResults.description: Maximum records per page (page size). Defaults to the API's own default when omitted.

params.description: Additional documented query-string filters to send verbatim (merged with the typed params above).

tools.name: get_booking
tools.title: Get a booking
tools.description: Fetch a single booking (appointment) by id. YCBM API: GET /v1/bookings/{bookingId}. Use `fields` to select which fields to return. Returns the booking object.

fields.description: Comma-separated field paths to return (e.g. "id,title,startsAt"). Supports dotted paths for nested objects. Omit to get the default field set.

tools.name: list_profiles
tools.title: List profiles (booking pages)
tools.description: List all profiles (booking pages) on the account. YCBM API: GET /v1/profiles. A profile is a bookable page with its own subdomain, appointment types, team members, and locations. Use `fields` to select fields (e.g. "id,title,subdomain"). Paginated via page (0-based) + maxResults. Returns a JSON array of profiles.

fields.description: Comma-separated field paths to return (e.g. "id,title,startsAt"). Supports dotted paths for nested objects. Omit to get the default field set.

page.description: Pagination page number, 0-based (offset-based paging). Use with maxResults.

maxResults.description: Maximum records per page (page size). Defaults to the API's own default when omitted.

params.description: Additional documented query-string filters to send verbatim (merged with the typed params above).

tools.name: get_profile
tools.title: Get a profile (booking page)
tools.description: Fetch a single profile (booking page) by id. YCBM API: GET /v1/profiles/{profileId}. Use `fields` to select fields, including nested sub-resources (appointmentTypes, teamMembers, locations). Returns the profile object.

fields.description: Comma-separated field paths to return (e.g. "id,title,startsAt"). Supports dotted paths for nested objects. Omit to get the default field set.

tools.name: list_team_members
tools.title: List a profile's team members
tools.description: List the team members configured on a profile (booking page). YCBM API: GET /v1/profiles/{profileId} with a teamMembers field selection. Returns the profile's teamMembers block (each member has id, name, email, description, pic, calendarId).

tools.name: list_appointment_types
tools.title: List a profile's appointment types
tools.description: List the appointment types configured on a profile (booking page). YCBM API: GET /v1/profiles/{profileId} with an appointmentTypes field selection. Returns the profile's appointmentTypes block (each with id, name, description, slotLength, price).

tools.name: list_locations
tools.title: List a profile's locations
tools.description: List the locations configured on a profile (booking page). YCBM API: GET /v1/profiles/{profileId} with a locations field selection. Returns the profile's locations block (each with id, kind, value, notes, strategy).

tools.name: list_available_accounts
tools.title: List available accounts (calendars)
tools.description: List the accounts/calendars available to your account — used to find the calendarId for a team member. YCBM API: GET /v1/{accountId}/availableAccounts (accountId is taken from your configured credentials). Returns a JSON array.

tools.name: youcanbookme_request
tools.title: Raw read request
tools.description: Power-user escape hatch: GET any YCBM API path not wrapped by a dedicated tool. READ-ONLY — only GET is allowed. Pass the FULL API path after the origin, starting with a slash, INCLUDING any query string, e.g. "/v1/bookings?maxResults=5" or "/v1/profiles". Returns the parsed JSON.

path.description: Full API path after the origin, starting with "/", e.g. "/v1/bookings?maxResults=5".

tools.name: create_booking
tools.title: Create a booking
tools.description: MUTATES YouCanBookMe data: creates a booking (appointment) on a profile. YCBM API: POST /v1/bookings (JSON). Required: profileId, startsAt, endsAt (ISO 8601 times). Optional: title, timeZone, locale, units. Complex fields like `answers` (form-field answers) and `linkFields` should be passed via the `fields` passthrough. Returns the created booking.

profileId.description: The profile (booking page) id to book on (required).

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for the booking (e.g. Europe/London).

units.description: Number of slot units to book.

fields.description: Additional documented YCBM fields to send in the JSON write body — merged OVER the typed fields above.

tools.name: update_booking
tools.title: Update a booking
tools.description: MUTATES YouCanBookMe data: updates an existing booking (reschedule, rename, mark cancelled/no-show). YCBM API: PATCH /v1/bookings/{bookingId} (JSON, partial update). Set any of title/startsAt/endsAt/cancelled/noShow/timeZone/locale/units; use the `fields` passthrough for answers/linkFields or other documented fields. The path id is never sent in the body.

bookingId.description: The booking id to update (path only; required).

cancelled.description: Set true to cancel the booking, false to un-cancel.

noShow.description: Mark the attendee as a no-show (true) or not (false).

fields.description: Additional documented YCBM fields to send in the JSON write body — merged OVER the typed fields above.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.title: Cancel a booking
tools.description: MUTATES YouCanBookMe data: cancels a booking. Convenience wrapper for PATCH /v1/bookings/{bookingId} with { cancelled: true } — safer and reversible (re-activate via update_booking cancelled=false) versus deleting. Returns the updated booking.

bookingId.description: The booking id to cancel (path only; required).

tools.name: update_profile
tools.title: Update a profile (booking page)
tools.description: MUTATES YouCanBookMe data: updates a profile's (booking page) configuration. YCBM API: PATCH /v1/profiles/{profileId} (JSON, partial update). Pass the fields to change via the `fields` passthrough (e.g. { title, subdomain, ... }) — profile fields are numerous and use YCBM's own names. The path id is never sent in the body.

profileId.description: The profile (booking page) id to update (path only; required).

fields.description: Additional documented YCBM fields to send in the JSON write body — merged OVER the typed fields above.

tools.name: create_appointment_type
tools.title: Create an appointment type
tools.description: MUTATES YouCanBookMe data: adds an appointment type to a profile. YCBM API: POST /v1/profiles/{profileId}/appointmenttypes/items (JSON). Required: name; use the `fields` passthrough for description, slotLength, price, etc. The path profileId is never sent in the body.

profileId.description: The profile (booking page) id (path only; required).

fields.description: Additional documented YCBM fields to send in the JSON write body — merged OVER the typed fields above.

tools.name: update_appointment_type
tools.title: Update an appointment type
tools.description: MUTATES YouCanBookMe data: updates an appointment type on a profile. YCBM API: PATCH /v1/profiles/{profileId}/appointmenttypes/items/{appointmentTypeId} (JSON, partial update). Pass changed fields (name, description, slotLength, price, ...) via the `fields` passthrough. Path ids are never sent in the body.

profileId.description: The profile (booking page) id (path only; required).

appointmentTypeId.description: The appointment type id to update (path only; required).

fields.description: Additional documented YCBM fields to send in the JSON write body — merged OVER the typed fields above.

tools.name: create_team_member
tools.title: Add a team member
tools.description: MUTATES YouCanBookMe data: adds a team member to a profile. YCBM API: POST /v1/profiles/{profileId}/teammembers/items (JSON). Required: name; calendarId links the member to a calendar (find it via list_available_accounts). Use the `fields` passthrough for email, description, pic, etc. The path profileId is never sent in the body.

profileId.description: The profile (booking page) id (path only; required).

calendarId.description: The calendar id to link (see list_available_accounts).

fields.description: Additional documented YCBM fields to send in the JSON write body — merged OVER the typed fields above.

tools.name: update_team_member
tools.title: Update a team member
tools.description: MUTATES YouCanBookMe data: updates a team member on a profile. YCBM API: PATCH /v1/profiles/{profileId}/teammembers/items/{teamMemberId} (JSON, partial update). Pass changed fields (name, email, description, calendarId, ...) via the `fields` passthrough. Path ids are never sent in the body.

profileId.description: The profile (booking page) id (path only; required).

teamMemberId.description: The team member id to update (path only; required).

fields.description: Additional documented YCBM fields to send in the JSON write body — merged OVER the typed fields above.

tools.name: create_location
tools.title: Add a location
tools.description: MUTATES YouCanBookMe data: adds a location to a profile. YCBM API: POST /v1/profiles/{profileId}/locations (JSON). Required: kind (location type) and strategy (how it is assigned). Use the `fields` passthrough for value, notes, and other documented fields. The path profileId is never sent in the body.

profileId.description: The profile (booking page) id (path only; required).

value.description: The location value (e.g. an address or link).

fields.description: Additional documented YCBM fields to send in the JSON write body — merged OVER the typed fields above.
